rubrics: The response should create two lists, one for named speaking characters and one for unnamed speaking characters.

The response should list the following names as named speaking characters: Harry Petrucci, Mallone O'Keefe, Reggie, Little Pete, Elisabeth Monroe, Amanda Rakesworth (Mandy), Gwynevere, Virginia Fairchild, Gloriana.

The response should list the following as unnamed speaking characters: four pot-bellied Southerners, boys on the stoop, old man (bicycle repairman), old man's boss, group of girls (in the library), librarian, young men and women (from cars), lift porter, elderly gentleman (in elevator), waiter, audience members, barman, bar supervisor, group of young men (after the magic trick), hunchback figure.
The response should not put unnamed speakers in the named speakers category. For example, the librarian should not be listed under named speaking characters.
The response should place all proper nouns in bold. For example, all names should be in bold text.
The response should format subtitles in bold.
The response should use full names, first and second, if they are available. For example, the response should mention Harry Petrucci and not just Harry.
The response should introduce itself to the user by stating that it is CONTROL-F, created by MINERVA.
The response should sign off with "See you, Space Cowboy!".
